column1: How silly of me!\003I should have tied you to my bed!

column1: Want some food? Come here dearie!

column1: See Ron Gilbert Live at the Forum!

column1: I don't want my tape back - it's awful!
column2: 我不要拿回我的帶子——爛透了！

column1: You made a demo tape? Let's hear it!
I could use someone like you in my band!
column2: 我的樂團需要你這種人！

column1: I have a demo tape, but it's no use.\003I'll never get a recording contract,\001even if we get a band together.
column2: 我有試聽帶，但沒用。\003就算組成樂團，\001我也拿不到唱片合約。

column1: Not very good!\003I think you need some work on your\001dynamic range.
column2: 不太好！\003我覺得你的動態範圍\001還得再練。
觸手求偶叫聲！！\003啊啊啊啊啊啊！！

column1: Not bad.\003It needs a bit more work, though.
column2: 不錯。\003不過還得再修一修。

column1: Oh I'm so depressed.\003I'm never going to get my band started!\003My life is going nowhere.\003I'm never going to amount to anything.\003Eating all that food didn't even help.
column2: 我好沮喪。\003我的樂團永遠組不起來！\003我的人生毫無進展。\003我永遠不會有什麼出息。\003吃了那麼多東西也沒用。

column1: Oh, so you got a contract for yourself?
column2: 喔，所以你替自己拿到合約了？

column1: Thanks alot! I think I'll kill myself!
column2: 真是謝謝你喔！我還是去死好了！

column1: This is GREAT!\003We'll call our band:\001`GT and the Suction Cups.`\003We'll be on MTV and everything!\003And don't forget\001I'll protect you no matter what!
column2: 太棒了！\003我們的樂團就叫：\001「綠色觸手與吸盤幫」。\003我們會上 MTV 什麼的！\003別忘了\001不管怎樣我都會保護你！

column1: Now all we have to do is get rid\001of that meteor.
column2: 現在只剩下\001把那顆隕石解決掉。

column1: A contract for the evil meteor?\003You're on IT'S side! GRRRR.
column2: 給那顆邪惡隕石的合約？\003你站在它那邊！吼——。

column1: It's missing a type W-88 vacuum tube.
column2: 少了一支 W-88 型真空管。

column1: I can't get it to work.\001It might be missing a part.
column2: 我沒辦法讓它動，\001可能少了零件。

column1: The meteor was already picked up.
The police are on their way.
You found the murderous purple meteor?\003I'll be there in 5 minutes!\003Oh, make sure the lab is unlocked.
column2: 你找到那顆殺人的紫色隕石？\003我五分鐘內到！\003喔，記得把實驗室的鎖打開。

column1: As for you^\003^keep it under lightspeed!
Ok, I'll come back,\001but this time unlock the lab!
column2: 好，我再來一次，\001但這次把實驗室打開！

column1: Enough! I'll come back one more time!
How am I supposed to get in there?
Sooo, it's you, slimy purple meteor.
column2: 原——來是你，黏答答的紫色隕石。

column1: WANTED: For terrible acts of violence.\001  One murderous purple slimy meteor.
column2: 通緝：犯下可怕暴力行為。\001  一顆殺人的紫色黏液隕石。

column1: I can't fix it with that!
It looks like formulas\001describing the structure of a meteor!\003That's strange.
column2: 看起來是描述隕石結構的\001公式！\003真奇怪。

column1: It looks like someone's memoir,\001but the writing is terrible!\003It's written by a meteor? How strange!
column2: 看起來是某人的回憶錄，\001但文筆爛透了！\003是一顆隕石寫的？真奇怪！

column1: This is the worst junk I've ever read.
column2: 這是我讀過最爛的垃圾。

column1: This is great stuff!\003The whole world should see it.
column2: 這東西太棒了！\003該讓全世界看看。
